            $null = & $sql (Get-SICiCmdbKeySaveSql) @{ ck = $cmdbKeysJson } 'rows'
        }
        & $mark 'finish'

        # #534 the run log: incremental or full, groups built / skipped, why a full ran -- and what the full reconcile corrected
        & $Log 'INFO' (Format-SICiBuildModeLine -Full $fullBuild -Reasons $reasons.ToArray() -Groups $nGroups -Built $built -Dirty $dirty -WorkSeconds $workSeconds)
        if ($fullBuild) {
            if ($carryOn) {
                & $Log 'INFO' ("CIs: the rebuild of every CI that a stopped build started is complete -- {0} CI(s) changed in this build." -f $t.Changed)
            } elseif ($decision.FingerprintChanged) {
                & $Log 'INFO' ("CIs: what the CIs are built from changed -- every CI was rebuilt; {0} of them changed." -f $t.Changed)
            } elseif ($mismatch.Count -gt 0) {
                # owner 2026-10-10: "no need to send alerts, if full reconcile fixes things" -- one plain INFO line (the count is
                # also kept in sidata.CiBuildState LastReconcileCorrected); it never changes the run outcome
                & $Log 'INFO' ("CIs: the weekly full rebuild brought {0} CI(s) up to date (first: {1})." -f $mismatch.Count, ((@($mismatch) | Select-Object -First 5) -join ', '))
            } else {
                & $Log 'INFO' 'CIs: the full reconcile found every CI as the incremental builds left it -- nothing to correct.'
            }
        }

        # the CI workbook (Excel) through its output map in force (data-model/outputs/excel-ci + the customer's column
        # changes) -- a listed data-out connector (config/data-out.locked.json, data-out-excel-ci): its run and each CI
        # written, changed (column before / now) or no longer in it are recorded. Never fails the build.
        if ($wbWanted -and $wbDocs.Count -gt 0) {
            try {
                if (-not (Get-Command -Name Invoke-SIDataOutWriter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { . ([IO.Path]::Combine((Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot), 'data-out', 'SI-DataOut.ps1')) }
                $wbCatalog = Get-SIDataOutCatalog   # one list (return , @()): filter the variable, never the call's pipeline
                $wbEntry = @($wbCatalog | Where-Object { [string]$_.output -eq 'excel-ci' })[0]
                $wbStore = $null; try { $wbStore = New-SIConnectorRegistryStore } catch { }
                # SI_DisabledAssets_Connectors (the workbook is data out): a disabled account's CI is left out of it, frozen
                $wbSel = Select-SIDataOutEnabledItems -Grain 'ci' -Items $wbDocs.ToArray() -Include (Test-SIDisabledIncluded -Stage Connectors -Policy $disabledPolicy)
                $wr = Invoke-SIDataOutWriter -Entry $wbEntry -Map $model.Outputs['excel-ci'] -Items @($wbSel.Kept) -ValueMaps $model['value-maps'].maps -Store $wbStore -RunId $RunId -Log $Log -FrozenKeys ([string[]]@($wbSel.FrozenKeys))
                if ($t.Cis -gt $wbDocs.Count) { & $Log 'INFO' ("CIs: {0} of {1} CI(s) in the workbook (a workbook holds up to {2}; every CI is in the database)" -f $wr.Rows, $t.Cis, $WorkbookMaxCis) }
                # #639: a WARNING of the build (every CI is whole in the database and the web app; only the file is missing)
                if ($wr -and [string]$wr.Outcome -in 'failed', 'partial') { $buildIssues.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Level = 'WARNING'; Text = ('the CI workbook was not written ({0}) -- every CI is in the database and the web app' -f [string]$wr.Why) }) }
            } catch {
                & $Log 'WARN' ("CIs: the CI workbook could not be written -- {0}" -f $_.Exception.Message)
                $buildIssues.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Level = 'WARNING'; Text = ('the CI workbook was not written ({0}) -- every CI is in the database and the web app' -f $_.Exception.Message) })
            }
        }
        & $mark 'workbook'

        $phaseText = (@($phase.Keys | ForEach-Object { '{0} {1} s' -f $_, $phase[$_] }) -join ', ')
        if ($DryRun) {
            & $Log 'OK' ("CIs: {0} record(s) -> {1} CI(s); {2} new, {3} merged -- DRY RUN, nothing written. Times: {4}" -f $nRec, $t.Cis, $t.Minted, $t.Merged, $phaseText)
        } else {
            & $Log 'OK' ("CIs: {0} record(s) -> {1} CI(s) ({2} changed, {3} new, {4} merged); SQL: {5} CI row(s), {6} link row(s), {7} record link(s), {8} daily row(s), {9} ledger anchor(s); SI_CI_CL: {10} seen + {11} full row(s), ~{12:N0} KB{13}. Times: {14}" -f `
                $nRec, $t.Cis, $t.Changed, $t.Minted, $t.Merged, ($t.Changed + $t.LastSeenOnly), $t.Links, $t.RecordCi, $t.Daily, $t.Anchors, $t.PostedSeen, $t.PostedFull, ($t.Bytes / 1KB), $(if ($full) { ' (weekly full refresh)' } else { '' }), $phaseText)
            if ($t.PostFailed -gt 0) {
                & $Log 'WARN' ("CIs: {0} batch(es) could not be posted to SI_CI_CL; the next build posts them." -f $t.PostFailed)
                # #639 FAILED: Risk Analysis reads its CI context from SI_CI_CL, and this build's rows of those batches are not there
                $buildIssues.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Level = 'FAILED'; Text = ('{0} batch(es) of CIs did not reach SI_CI_CL -- Risk Analysis would read those CIs from an older build or not at all; the next build posts every CI''s row again' -f $t.PostFailed) })
            }
            & $Log 'INFO' ("CIs: {0} of {1} CI(s) unchanged since the last build -- sent without their document{2}" -f $t.Slim, $t.Cis, $(if ($t.Resent -gt 0) { ("; {0} found changed by the database and sent whole" -f $t.Resent) } else { '' }))
        }
        # #642 the identity ledger's wrong merges (sidata.CiBuildState WrongMergesSplit / SharedIdGroups keep the counts)
        foreach ($wl in @(Format-SICiWrongMergeLines -Split $t.WrongMergeSplit -SplitIds $wrongIds.ToArray() -SharedGroups $t.Collisions -SharedIds $collIds.ToArray())) { & $Log 'WARN' $wl }
        # #546 (counted over the CIs this build evaluated -- an incremental build evaluates only the CIs whose records changed)
        $unkLine = ''; try { $unkLine = Format-SICiUnknownFactorLine -Counts $unknownFactorCounts } catch { }
        if ($unkLine) { & $Log 'INFO' $unkLine }
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Failed = $false; Records = $nRec; CiCount = $t.Cis; Cis = $raCis.ToArray(); Changed = $t.Changed; Minted = $t.Minted; Merged = $t.Merged; Unkeyable = $unkeyable; Slim = $t.Slim; Resent = $t.Resent
            PostedSeen = $t.PostedSeen; PostedFull = $t.PostedFull; Bytes = $t.Bytes; SqlRows = ($t.Changed + $t.LastSeenOnly + $t.Links + $t.RecordCi + $t.Daily + $t.Anchors); Full = [bool]$full; Phases = $phase
            # #534 the build's mode and what it did
            BuildMode = $(if ($fullBuild) { 'full' } else { 'incremental' }); FullBuild = [bool]$fullBuild; FullReasons = $reasons.ToArray(); GroupsBuilt = $built
            # a rebuild of every CI that was stopped, carried on by this build; the batches this build kept as finished
            CarryOn = [bool]$carryOn; BatchesKept = $batchesKept
            GroupsSkipped = [Math]::Max(0, $nGroups - $built); SkippedCis = $skippedCis; Touched = $t.Touched; Marked = $t.Marked; Dirty = $dirty
            # the CIs whose rules took too long: kept out until fully evaluated (Kept = their last complete evaluation stays in
            # force, LeftOut = new and not written), built again in the next run; their names (name and kind, the first 50)
            Incomplete = $t.Incomplete; IncompleteKept = $t.IncompleteKept; IncompleteLeftOut = $t.IncompleteLeftOut; IncompleteCis = $heldNames.ToArray()
            ReconcileCorrected = $mismatch.Count; ReconcileCorrectedIds = $mismatch.ToArray(); Fingerprint = $fingerprint; IdentityLinked = $t.IdentityLinked
            # #642 the identity ledger's wrong merges this build split off, and the groups that still share an id (built as one CI)
            WrongMergeSplit = $t.WrongMergeSplit; WrongMergeSplitIds = $wrongIds.ToArray(); SharedIdGroups = $t.Collisions; SharedIds = $collIds.ToArray(); DuplicateCis = $t.Duplicates
            # #493 / #496 the graph
            GraphCis = $gt.Cis; ServiceMemberships = $gt.Services; RelationClaims = $gt.Claims; ServiceChanges = $gt.ServiceChanges; GraphMissing = $graphMissing; Relations = $rel
            # the CIs no source records any more, retired this build
            Retired = $(if ($retired) { [int](Get-SIItemValue $retired 'Retired') } else { 0 })
            # the CI views' stored columns filled at the end of this build ($null: not this edition, or a dry run)
            ViewColumns = $viewColumns
            # #639 what the build caught and went on from (WARNING / FAILED, one plain line each)
            Issues = $buildIssues.ToArray() }
    } catch {
        Stop-SICiWatch -Watch $ciWatch
        # an unreachable database lands here too (the first statement is the grouping): a plain failure with its reason --
        # never a Log Analytics fallback
        & $Log 'WARN' ("CIs could not be built this run -- {0}. The correlation map is unaffected; the next build tries again." -f $_.Exception.Message)
        # #534 the next build is full (best effort: the database may be what failed). Not after a lost lock: the build's
        # state may be another build's by now, and a stopped build is carried on by the next one as it is
        if ($stateRunning -and $sql -and -not $lockLost) { try { $null = & $sql (Get-SICiStateSetSql) @{ j = (ConvertTo-SIJsonArray @([ordered]@{ n = 'LastBuildStatus'; v = 'failed' })) } 'rows' } catch { } }
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Failed = $true; Reason = $_.Exception.Message; CiCount = 0; Cis = @() }
    } finally {
        # the lock this build took is released whatever happened (a killed process: the server frees it with the connection)
        if ($lockOwned) { Exit-SICiBuildLock }
    }
}

# ---- SI-CiBuildSql.ps1 :: ConvertTo-SICiPostRow
function ConvertTo-SICiPostRow {
    <# PURE. A CI document -> the SI_CI_CL full row Risk Analysis reads (the column contract only, $script:SICiPostFields: no
       run id and nothing else that changes every build; the lifecycle IS posted -- it changes only when the CI's linked
       objects do; linked objects as { provider, id }, risk factors as { id, axis, impact, stage }). #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$Ci)
    $r = [ordered]@{}
    foreach ($f in $script:SICiPostFields) {
        if (-not $Ci.Contains($f)) { continue }
        $v = $Ci[$f]
        if ($f -eq 'si_linked_objects') { $v = @(@($v) | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ provider = $_.provider; id = $_.id } }) }
        elseif ($f -eq 'si_risk_factors') {
            # each factor's providers ('by', #464) ride along; the full evidence stays in the sidata.Ci document
            $v = @(@($v) | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object {
                    # #559: shortName / side / state ride along; axis + stage stay for the reports' CI blocks (si_rf_p / si_rf_c)
                    $o = [ordered]@{ id = $_.id; shortName = (Get-SIItemValue $_ 'shortName'); side = (Get-SIItemValue $_ 'side'); axis = $_.axis; impact = $_.impact; state = (Get-SIItemValue $_ 'state'); stage = $_.stage }
                    $by = Get-SIItemValue $_ 'by'; if ($null -ne $by -and @($by).Count -gt 0) { $o['by'] = @($by) }
                    $o })
        }
        elseif ($f -eq 'si_tier' -and $null -ne $v -and "$v" -ne '') { $v = [int]$v }
        elseif ($f -eq 'si_tier_claims') {
            $v = @(@($v) | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ -and $null -ne (Get-SIItemValue $_ 'tier') -and "$(Get-SIItemValue $_ 'tier')" -ne '' } | ForEach-Object {
                    [ordered]@{ rule = (Get-SIItemValue $_ 'rule'); label = (Get-SIItemValue $_ 'label'); kind = (Get-SIItemValue $_ 'kind'); tier = [int](Get-SIItemValue $_ 'tier')
                        admissible = [bool](Get-SIItemValue $_ 'admissible'); winner = [bool](Get-SIItemValue $_ 'winner'); reason = (Get-SIItemValue $_ 'reason')
                        matched = @(@(Get-SIItemValue $_ 'matched') | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) } })
        }
        $r[$f] = ConvertTo-SILogValue $v
    }
    # #464: the catalog's per-CI factor columns -- si_rf_<id> (true / false) and si_rf_count -- when the CI build set them
    foreach ($k in @($Ci.Keys)) { if ([string]$k -like 'si_rf_*') { $r[[string]$k] = ConvertTo-SILogValue $Ci[$k] } }
    $r['si_collection_time'] = ConvertTo-SILogValue $Ci['si_collection_time']
    $r['si_last_seen'] = ConvertTo-SILogValue $Ci['si_last_seen']
    [pscustomobject]$r
}

# ---- SI-CiBuildSql.ps1 :: ConvertTo-SICiSqlItems
function ConvertTo-SICiSqlItems {
    <#
        PURE. A batch's CI documents -> the sidata.Ci items (grid columns, the whole document, its content hash), the
        sidata.CiLink items, the record -> CI map and the SI_CI_CL rows with their posted-content hash.
        #515 -Stored (Get-SICiBatchStored: what the last build left): a CI whose content hash equals its stored one goes as a
        SLIM item (id, last seen, collection time, hash -- no document, no grid columns, no links: the database keeps them and
        only moves its last seen), and a record -> CI link that did not move is not sent. Unchanged = how many went slim.
        Without -Stored every CI goes whole (the first build, a resend).
    #>
    param([AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Cis = @(), $Stored)
    $storedHash = if ($Stored -and $Stored.Hash) { $Stored.Hash } else { @{} }
    $storedRec = if ($Stored -and $Stored.RecordCi) { $Stored.RecordCi } else { @{} }
    $unchanged = 0
    $iso = { param($v) $x = $v; if ($x -isnot [datetime]) { $x = ConvertTo-SIUtcOrNull $x }; if ($x) { $x.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') } else { $null } }
    $ciItems = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $links = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $map = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $post = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    # one item per CI id: two groups that resolve to one id (a ledger collision) would break the batch's write -- the
    # first is kept and the others are counted (Duplicates), never written twice
    $ids = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]' ([StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase); $dup = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    foreach ($c in $Cis) {
        if ($null -eq $c) { continue }
        $id = [string]$c['si_ci_id']; if (-not $id) { continue }
        if (-not $ids.Add($id)) { $dup.Add($id); continue }
        $rf = @(@($c['si_risk_factors']) | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.impact -gt 0 } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.id })
        $tier = $c['si_tier']; $ie = $c['si_internet_exposed']
        $hashIn = [ordered]@{}
        foreach ($k in $c.Keys) {
            if ($script:SICiVolatileFields -contains $k) { continue }
            if ($k -eq 'si_linked_objects') { $hashIn[$k] = @(@($c[$k]) | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ provider = $_.provider; type = $_.type; id = $_.id; record_key = $_.record_key; primary = [bool]$_.primary; state = $_.state } }); continue }
            $hashIn[$k] = $c[$k]
        }
        $hash = Get-SIContentHash -Item $hashIn
        # the SI_CI_CL full row and its posted-content hash, first: the CI item carries that hash too (#534 PostRowHash -- a CI
        # whose last full row did not reach SI_CI_CL is rebuilt by the next incremental build)
        $pr = ConvertTo-SICiPostRow -Ci $c
        $ph = Get-SIContentHash -Item $pr -Exclude @('si_collection_time', 'si_last_seen')
        $was = [string]$storedHash[$id]
        if ($was -and $was.ToUpperInvariant() -eq $hash.ToUpperInvariant()) {
            # #515 the content did not change: no document is serialised or sent, no link rows
            $unchanged++
            $ciItems.Add([ordered]@{ CiId = $id; LastSeen = (& $iso $c['si_last_seen']); CollectionTime = (& $iso $c['si_collection_time']); Hash = $hash; DocJson = $null; PostHash = $ph })
            foreach ($l in @($c['si_linked_objects'])) {
                if ($null -eq $l -or -not $l.id -or -not $l.record_key) { continue }
                if ([string]$storedRec[[string]$l.record_key] -ne $id) { $map.Add([ordered]@{ RecordKey = [string]$l.record_key; CiId = $id }) }
            }
        } else {
        $ciItems.Add([ordered]@{
                CiId = $id; Class = [string]$c['si_class']; Name = [string]$c['si_asset_name']; AssetType = [string]$c['si_asset_type']
                Tier = $(if ($null -ne $tier -and "$tier" -ne '') { [int]$tier } else { $null }); TierSetBy = [string]$c['si_tier_set_by']
                TierReason = [string]$c['si_tier_reason']; Lifecycle = [string]$c['si_lifecycle']
                InternetExposed = $(if ($null -eq $ie) { $null } elseif ((ConvertTo-SIBoolOrNull $ie) -eq $true) { 1 } elseif ((ConvertTo-SIBoolOrNull $ie) -eq $false) { 0 } else { $null })
                CmdbId = [string]$c['si_cmdb_id']; CmdbName = [string]$c['si_cmdb_name']; CmdbCriticality = [string]$c['si_cmdb_criticality']
                CriticalityFactor = $c['si_criticality_factor']; RiskFactors = ($rf -join ';'); LinkCount = $c['si_link_count']
                LastSeen = (& $iso $c['si_last_seen']); CollectionTime = (& $iso $c['si_collection_time'])
                Hash = $hash; PostHash = $ph
                DocJson = (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $c -Compress -Depth 12)
            })
        foreach ($l in @($c['si_linked_objects'])) {
            if ($null -eq $l -or -not $l.id) { continue }
            $links.Add([ordered]@{ CiId = $id; Provider = [string]$l.provider; RecordType = [string]$l.type; NativeId = [string]$l.id; IsPrimary = $(if ($l.primary -eq $true) { 1 } else { 0 }); State = [string]$l.state; LastSeen = (& $iso $l.last_seen) })
            if ($l.record_key -and [string]$storedRec[[string]$l.record_key] -ne $id) { $map.Add([ordered]@{ RecordKey = [string]$l.record_key; CiId = $id }) }
        }
        }
        $pr | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'si_row_kind' -NotePropertyValue 'full'
        $pr | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'si_content_hash' -NotePropertyValue $ph
        # the SLIM row every CI gets every build (operator: "a device can be off for 1 week, how do we find its latest data if
        # you filter per day"): today's set of CIs = today's seen rows; a CI's properties = its latest FULL row
        $seen = [pscustomobject][ordered]@{ si_ci_id = $id; si_row_kind = 'seen'; si_collection_time = $pr.si_collection_time; si_content_hash = $ph
            si_last_seen = $pr.si_last_seen }
        $post.Add([pscustomobject]@{ CiId = $id; Row = $pr; Seen = $seen; Hash = $ph })
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Cis = $ciItems.ToArray(); Links = $links.ToArray(); Map = $map.ToArray(); Post = $post.ToArray(); Duplicates = $dup.ToArray(); Unchanged = $unchanged }
}

# ---- SI-CiEnrich.ps1 :: Get-SICiConditionMatches
function Get-SICiConditionMatches {
    <#
        PURE. What made a condition true on an item: one entry per leaf that matched -- { field; values } with the VALUES of the
        field that satisfy the leaf (the tag, the software, the name), not the whole field. An 'any' group gives the leaves that
        matched, an 'all' group every leaf. Feeds the tier explanation (si_tier_explanation, #579).
    #>
    param($Condition, $Item, [hashtable]$Context)
    $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    if ($null -eq $Condition) { return }
    foreach ($k in 'all', 'any') {
        $has = ($Condition -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -and $Condition.Contains($k)) -or ($Condition -isnot [System.Collections.IDictionary] -and $Condition.PSObject.Properties[$k])
        if (-not $has) { continue }
        foreach ($c in (Get-SIValueList (Get-SIItemValue $Condition $k))) {
            $ok = $false; try { $ok = Test-SICondition -Condition $c -Item $Item -Context $Context } catch { $ok = $false }
            if ($ok) { foreach ($m in @(Get-SICiConditionMatches -Condition $c -Item $Item -Context $Context)) { $out.Add($m) } }
        }
        return $out.ToArray()   # unrolled: the caller collects with @()
    }
    $field = [string](Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'field'); if (-not $field) { return }
    $op = [string](Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'op')
    $actual = Get-SIItemValue $Item $field
    $vals = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    if (@('matches', 'like', 'contains', 'eq', 'in', 'contains_any', 'in_ranges', 'in_list') -contains $op) {
        foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) {
            $one = @{}; $one[$field] = $v
            $ok = $false; try { $ok = Test-SICondition -Condition $Condition -Item $one -Context $Context } catch { $ok = $false }
            if ($ok) { $vals.Add($v) }
        }
    }
    if ($vals.Count -eq 0) { foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) { $vals.Add($v) } }
    $out.Add([ordered]@{ field = $field; values = $vals.ToArray() })
    return $out.ToArray()
}

# ---- SI-CiEnrich.ps1 :: Invoke-SICiRiskFactors
function Invoke-SICiRiskFactors {
    <# Asset risk factors + CI-level coverage checks on one CI -> si_risk_factors, si_coverage_gaps. #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$Ci, [Parameter(Mandatory)]$Factors, $Checks, [hashtable]$Context)
    $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $byId = @{}
    foreach ($f in @($Factors.factors)) { $byId[[string]$f.id] = $f }
    # #546 UNKNOWN IS NEVER A FINDING: a factor whose value the CI cannot decide (a field in si_unknown_fields, or an age /
    # number that was never read) is listed in si_rf_unknown and counted -- never raised
    $unknownFields = @(@($Ci['si_unknown_fields']) | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
    $unknownFactors = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    # #559 risk factor model v2: an ENABLED factor is evaluated and counts its impact (1..5) on its side of the score; a
    # disabled one is not evaluated (a built-in factor is always enabled). Each entry keeps 'axis' (the report column its
    # short name is listed in -- the reports' CI blocks read si_rf_p / si_rf_c by it) and 'stage' = production (what the
    # pre-v2 readers and the shipped CI blocks filter on), and adds shortName / side / state.
    foreach ($f in @($Factors.factors)) {
        if ([string]$f.appliesTo -ne 'asset' -or [string]$f.evaluatedBy -ne 'catalog' -or -not (Test-SIRiskFactorEnabled $f)) { continue }
        $hit = $false
        try { $hit = Test-SIConditionTri -Condition $f.when -Item $Ci -Context $Context -UnknownFields $unknownFields } catch { $hit = $false }
        if ($null -eq $hit) { $unknownFactors.Add([string]$f.id); continue }
        if ($hit -ne $true) { continue }
        $out.Add([ordered]@{ id = [string]$f.id; shortName = (Get-SIRiskFactorShortName $f); name = [string]$f.name; axis = [string]$f.axis; side = 'asset'; impact = (Get-SIRiskFactorImpact $f); state = 'enabled'; stage = 'production'; tokens = @($f.legacyTokens) })
    }
    $gaps = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    foreach ($ck in @($Checks.checks)) {
        if ([string]$ck.scope -ne 'ci' -or $null -eq $ck.fail) { continue }
        $failed = $false
        try { $failed = Test-SICondition -Condition $ck.fail -Item $Ci -Context $Context } catch { $failed = $false }
        if (-not $failed) { continue }
        $gaps.Add([ordered]@{ id = [string]$ck.id; name = [string]$ck.name })
        $fid = [string]$ck.riskFactor
        if ($fid -and $byId.ContainsKey($fid) -and -not @($out | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $fid }).Count -and (Test-SIRiskFactorEnabled $byId[$fid])) {
            $f = $byId[$fid]
            $out.Add([ordered]@{ id = $fid; shortName = (Get-SIRiskFactorShortName $f); name = [string]$f.name; axis = [string]$f.axis; side = (Get-SIRiskFactorSide $f); impact = (Get-SIRiskFactorImpact $f); state = 'enabled'; stage = 'production'; tokens = @($f.legacyTokens); coverage = [string]$ck.id })
        }
    }
    $Ci['si_risk_factors'] = $out.ToArray()
    if ($gaps.Count -gt 0) { $Ci['si_coverage_gaps'] = $gaps.ToArray() }
    # a factor a coverage check raised is decided, not unknown
    foreach ($e in $out) { if ($unknownFactors.Contains([string]$e.id)) { $null = $unknownFactors.Remove([string]$e.id) } }
    if ($unknownFactors.Count -gt 0) { $Ci['si_rf_unknown'] = $unknownFactors.ToArray() } elseif ($Ci.Contains('si_rf_unknown')) { $Ci.Remove('si_rf_unknown') }
    # #464: each factor's evidence (which provider / field proves it), si_rf_<id> + si_rf_count (SI-RiskFactorCatalog.ps1)
    $lists = @{}; if ($Context -and $Context.Lists) { $lists = $Context.Lists }
    $null = Add-SICiRiskFactorEvidence -Ci $Ci -Factors $Factors -Lists $lists
    return $Ci
}

# ---- SI-CiEnrich.ps1 :: Invoke-SICiEnrichment
function Invoke-SICiEnrichment {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS  P3 over a set of CIs: rules (tier, purpose, category, CMDB values, tags), risk factors + coverage, criticality.
    #>
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Cis,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]$Model,
        [AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Rules = @(),
        [string]$CmdbOwner = 'cmdb',
        # the owning CMDB's services / CIs (New-SICiCmdbIndex); none = only what the rules set
        [hashtable]$CmdbIndex,
        [datetime]$Now = [datetime]::UtcNow,
        # #462 manual CI overrides in force (ConvertTo-SICiOverrideIndex): CiId -> overrides, applied over the rules
        [hashtable]$Overrides,
        # #496 the business services (New-SICiServiceIndex): which services own each CI and what it inherits; none = not set
        [hashtable]$ServiceIndex,
        # the build's watch (Start-SICiWatch): where the step stands, so a step that takes long says which CI it is working on
        $Watch
    )
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'SI-DataModelTemplates.ps1')
    # the customer's exposed network ranges (SI_InternetExposedRanges) join the internet_exposed_ranges list (#458)
    $ctx = @{ Lists = (Merge-SIRiskFactorRanges -Lists (Get-SIDataModelListContext $Model)); Now = $Now }
    $trust = Get-SICiTrustIndex $Model['trust']
    $byClass = Get-SICiRulesByClass -Rules $Rules
    # #496 the environments, strictest first (the list service_environment_order)
    $envOrder = [string[]]@()
    if ($ServiceIndex) { $el = $ctx.Lists['service_environment_order']; if ($el) { $envOrder = [string[]]@(@($el.values) | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) } }
    # PowerShell 7 with more than one CPU: the CIs in chunks on parallel threads (each its own runspace with these files
    # loaded and its own field cache; a CI is only ever touched by one thread). 5.1 / one CPU: the loop below.
    $budget = Get-SICiRulesBudgetSeconds
    $threads = Get-SICiParallelism -Count @($Cis).Count
    Set-SICiWatchPhase -Watch $Watch -Phase 'applying the rules, the services and the risk factors' -Total @($Cis).Count
    if ($threads -gt 1) {
        $size = [int][Math]::Ceiling(@($Cis).Count / ($threads * 4))
        $chunks = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Cis.Count; $i += $size) { $chunks.Add(@($Cis[$i..([Math]::Min($i + $size, $Cis.Count) - 1)])) }
        $dir = $PSScriptRoot
        # built from text: PowerShell 5.1 never parses a using-variable block it cannot run
        $body = [scriptblock]::Create(@'
try {
    . (Join-Path $using:dir 'SI-CiEnrich.ps1')
    . (Join-Path $using:dir 'SI-DataModelTemplates.ps1')
    $fc = @{}
    $w = $using:Watch; $slot = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'); $n = 0
    foreach ($ci in $_) {
        if ($w) { $w.Slots[$slot] = @((Get-SICiWatchLabel $ci), [datetime]::UtcNow.Ticks, $n) }
        $null = Set-SICiBreakGlass -Ci $ci -Context $using:ctx
        $null = Invoke-SICiRules -Ci $ci -Rules $using:Rules -Trust $using:trust -Context $using:ctx -Now $using:Now -RulesByClass $using:byClass -FieldCache $fc -BudgetSeconds $using:budget
        if ($using:Overrides) { $null = Set-SICiOverrides -Ci $ci -Index $using:Overrides }
        if ($using:CmdbIndex) { $null = Set-SICiCmdb -Ci $ci -Index $using:CmdbIndex -CmdbOwner $using:CmdbOwner }
        if ($using:ServiceIndex) { $null = Set-SICiServices -Ci $ci -Index $using:ServiceIndex -Mapping ($using:Model)['criticality-mapping'] -EnvironmentOrder $using:envOrder -CmdbOwner $using:CmdbOwner }
        $null = Set-SICiCriticality -Ci $ci -Mapping ($using:Model)['criticality-mapping'] -CmdbOwner $using:CmdbOwner
        $null = Invoke-SICiRiskFactors -Ci $ci -Factors ($using:Model)['risk-factors'] -Checks ($using:Model)['coverage-checks'] -Context $using:ctx
        $n++
    }
    if ($w) { $w.Slots[$slot] = @('', [datetime]::UtcNow.Ticks, $n) }
} catch { [pscustomobject]@{ SIEnrichError = ('{0} (at {1})' -f $_.Exception.Message, ((([string]$_.ScriptStackTrace) -split "`n")[0]).Trim()) } }
'@)
        $failed = @($chunks | ForEach-Object -ThrottleLimit $threads -Parallel $body | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.PSObject.Properties['SIEnrichError'] })
        if ($failed.Count -gt 0) { throw ('CI enrichment failed on {0} of {1} chunk(s): {2}' -f $failed.Count, $chunks.Count, $failed[0].SIEnrichError) }
        return , $Cis
    }
    $fieldCache = @{}
    $n = 0
    foreach ($ci in $Cis) {
        if ($Watch) { $Watch.Slots['main'] = @((Get-SICiWatchLabel $ci), [datetime]::UtcNow.Ticks, $n) }
        $n++
        $null = Set-SICiBreakGlass -Ci $ci -Context $ctx
        $null = Invoke-SICiRules -Ci $ci -Rules $Rules -Trust $trust -Context $ctx -Now $Now -RulesByClass $byClass -FieldCache $fieldCache -BudgetSeconds $budget
        if ($Overrides) { $null = Set-SICiOverrides -Ci $ci -Index $Overrides }
        if ($CmdbIndex) { $null = Set-SICiCmdb -Ci $ci -Index $CmdbIndex -CmdbOwner $CmdbOwner }
        if ($ServiceIndex) { $null = Set-SICiServices -Ci $ci -Index $ServiceIndex -Mapping $Model['criticality-mapping'] -EnvironmentOrder $envOrder -CmdbOwner $CmdbOwner }
        $null = Set-SICiCriticality -Ci $ci -Mapping $Model['criticality-mapping'] -CmdbOwner $CmdbOwner
        $null = Invoke-SICiRiskFactors -Ci $ci -Factors $Model['risk-factors'] -Checks $Model['coverage-checks'] -Context $ctx
    }
    return , $Cis
}

# ---- SI-FieldResolution.ps1 :: Get-SICiFieldConflicts
function Get-SICiFieldConflicts {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS  PURE. The fresh candidates of a single-value (authority) field that disagree with the resolved value.
    .PARAMETER Candidates  as Resolve-SICiField takes them: @{ Record; Provider; Key; State }
    .PARAMETER Resolved    Resolve-SICiField's result (@{ Value; Provider; Record; Stale })
    .OUTPUTS   [ [ordered]@{ provider; record; value; observed_at } ] -- at most 5, freshest first; empty when the field
               is not an authority field, the value is stale (nothing fresh to disagree with) or every source agrees.
    #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$Field, [Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Candidates, $Resolved, [datetime]$Now = [datetime]::UtcNow)
    $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    if ($null -eq $Resolved -or [bool]$Resolved.Stale) { return , $out.ToArray() }
    if ([string]$Field.resolution.policy -ne 'authority') { return , $out.ToArray() }
    $staleDays = 30
    if ($null -ne $Field.resolution.staleDays) { $staleDays = [double]$Field.resolution.staleDays }
    $win = ConvertTo-SIFieldCompareText $Resolved.Value
    $seenText = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]' ([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
    $rows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    foreach ($c in $Candidates) {
        if ($null -eq $c -or [string]$c.Key -eq [string]$Resolved.Record) { continue }
        $v = Get-SIItemValue $c.Record ([string]$Field.name)
        if (Test-SIValueEmpty $v) { if (-not ($v -is [bool])) { continue } }
        $seen = ConvertTo-SIUtcOrNull (Get-SIItemValue $c.Record 'si_source_last_seen')
        $fresh = ($c.State -in 'active', 'frozen') -and ($null -ne $seen) -and ((($Now - $seen).TotalDays) -le $staleDays)
        if (-not $fresh) { continue }
        $t = ConvertTo-SIFieldCompareText $v
        if ($t -eq $win) { continue }
        $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Seen = $seen; Text = $t; Entry = [ordered]@{ provider = [string]$c.Provider; record = [string]$c.Key; value = $v; observed_at = $seen } })
    }
    foreach ($r in @($rows.ToArray() | Sort-Object -Property @{ Expression = { $_.Seen }; Descending = $true })) {
        if ($out.Count -ge $script:SIFieldConflictMax) { break }
        if (-not $seenText.Add(('{0}|{1}' -f $r.Entry.provider, $r.Text))) { continue }
        $out.Add($r.Entry)
    }
    return , $out.ToArray()
}

# ---- SI-Conditions.ps1 :: Test-SICondition
function Test-SICondition {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS  Evaluates a condition (leaf or all/any group) against an item. Returns $true / $false.
    #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$Condition, $Item, [hashtable]$Context)
    if ($null -eq $Condition) { return $true }
    $all = Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'all'
    $any = Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'any'
    $hasAll = ($Condition -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -and $Condition.Contains('all')) -or ($Condition.PSObject.Properties['all'])
    $hasAny = ($Condition -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -and $Condition.Contains('any')) -or ($Condition.PSObject.Properties['any'])
    if ($hasAll) {
        foreach ($c in (Get-SIValueList $all)) { if (-not (Test-SICondition -Condition $c -Item $Item -Context $Context)) { return $false } }
        return $true
    }
    if ($hasAny) {
        foreach ($c in (Get-SIValueList $any)) { if (Test-SICondition -Condition $c -Item $Item -Context $Context) { return $true } }
        return $false
    }

    $field = [string](Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'field')
    $op = [string](Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'op')
    $expected = Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'value'
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($field)) { throw "condition without a field: $($Condition | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5)" }
    $actual = Get-SIItemValue $Item $field

    switch ($op) {
        'eq' { foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) { if (Test-SIScalarEqual $v $expected) { return $true } }; return $false }
        'ne' { foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) { if (Test-SIScalarEqual $v $expected) { return $false } }; return (-not (Test-SIValueEmpty $actual)) }
        'in' {
            $set = Resolve-SIListValues $expected $Context
            foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) { foreach ($e in $set) { if (Test-SIScalarEqual $v $e) { return $true } } }
            return $false
        }
        'not_in' {
            if (Test-SIValueEmpty $actual) { return $false }
            $set = Resolve-SIListValues $expected $Context
            foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) { foreach ($e in $set) { if (Test-SIScalarEqual $v $e) { return $false } } }
            return $true
        }
        'is_true' { return ((ConvertTo-SIBoolOrNull $actual) -eq $true) }
        'is_false' { $b = ConvertTo-SIBoolOrNull $actual; return ($null -ne $b -and $b -eq $false) }
        'is_empty' { return (Test-SIValueEmpty $actual) }
        'not_empty' { return (-not (Test-SIValueEmpty $actual)) }
        { $_ -in 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' } {
            $e = ConvertTo-SINumberOrNull $expected
            if ($null -eq $e) { throw "condition '$field $op' needs a number, got '$expected'" }
            foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) {
                $n = ConvertTo-SINumberOrNull $v
                if ($null -eq $n) { continue }
                $ok = switch ($op) { 'gt' { $n -gt $e } 'gte' { $n -ge $e } 'lt' { $n -lt $e } 'lte' { $n -le $e } }
                if ($ok) { return $true }
            }
            return $false
        }
        'contains' {
            if ($actual -is [string]) { return ($actual.IndexOf([string]$expected, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) }
            foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) {
                if (Test-SIScalarEqual $v $expected) { return $true }
                $vn = Get-SIItemValue $v 'name'; $vv = Get-SIItemValue $v 'value'          # si_tags entries {source, name, value}
                if ($null -ne $vn -and ((Test-SIScalarEqual $vn $expected) -or (Test-SIScalarEqual $vv $expected) -or (Test-SIScalarEqual ("{0}={1}" -f $vn, $vv) $expected))) { return $true }
            }
            return $false
        }
        'contains_any' {
            $set = Resolve-SIListValues $expected $Context
            foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) { foreach ($e in $set) { if (Test-SIScalarEqual $v $e) { return $true } } }
            return $false
        }
        'matches' {
            # bounded: a pathological pattern times out instead of hanging the run. value = one pattern or a list (any).
            # A tag entry {source, name, value} is matched as "name=value", as its name and as its value.
            # A pattern is built once and kept; a long list's match texts are made once per item (Get-SIMatchTextList).
            $tl = Get-SIMatchTextList $field $actual
            foreach ($pat in (Get-SIValueList $expected)) {
                $rx = Get-SIConditionRegex ([string]$pat)
                if ($null -ne $tl) { foreach ($s in $tl.Texts) { if ($rx.IsMatch($s)) { return $true } } }
                else { foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) { foreach ($s in (Get-SIMatchTexts $v)) { if ($rx.IsMatch($s)) { return $true } } } }
            }
            return $false
        }
        'like' {
            # PowerShell wildcards (* ? [ab]), case-insensitive; value = one pattern or a list (any). Tag entries as in matches.
            # A pattern is built once and kept. A long list (a device's installed software) is matched ONCE per pattern: a
            # wildcard of plain text and '*' by one search over the list's texts joined together, any other wildcard text
            # by text -- never value by value through a function call (see the block above Get-SIConditionRegex).
            $tl = Get-SIMatchTextList $field $actual
            foreach ($pat in (Get-SIValueList $expected)) {
                $p = [string]$pat
                if ($null -ne $tl) {
                    if ($tl.Texts.Length -eq 0) { continue }
                    if ($null -ne $tl.Joined) {
                        $line = Get-SIWildcardLineRegex $p
                        if ($null -ne $line) {
                            $found = $null
                            try { $found = $line.IsMatch($tl.Joined) } catch { $found = $null }
                            if ($found -eq $true) { return $true }
                            if ($found -eq $false) { continue }
                        }
                    }
                    $wc = Get-SIConditionWildcard $p
                    foreach ($s in $tl.Texts) { if ($wc.IsMatch($s)) { return $true } }
                    continue
                }
                $wc = Get-SIConditionWildcard $p
                foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) { foreach ($s in (Get-SIMatchTexts $v)) { if ($wc.IsMatch($s)) { return $true } } }
            }
            return $false
        }
        { $_ -in 'older_than_days', 'newer_than_days' } {
            $days = ConvertTo-SINumberOrNull $expected
            if ($null -eq $days) { throw "condition '$field $op' needs a number of days, got '$expected'" }
            $now = [datetime]::UtcNow
            if ($Context -and $Context.Now) { $now = ([datetime]$Context.Now).ToUniversalTime() }
            $t = ConvertTo-SIUtcOrNull $actual
            if ($null -eq $t) { return $false }
            $age = ($now - $t).TotalDays
            if ($op -eq 'older_than_days') { return ($age -gt $days) }
            return ($age -le $days)
        }
        'in_ranges' {
            $ranges = Resolve-SIListValues $expected $Context
            foreach ($ip in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) { foreach ($r in $ranges) { if (Test-SIIpInCidr ([string]$ip) ([string]$r)) { return $true } } }
            return $false
        }
        'in_list' {
            $id = [string]$expected
            if (-not ($Context -and $Context.Lists -and $Context.Lists.ContainsKey($id))) { throw "condition '$field in_list $id': no such list" }
            $l = $Context.Lists[$id]
            $type = [string](Get-SIItemValue $l 'type')
            if ($type -eq 'conditions') {
                foreach ($entry in (Get-SIValueList (Get-SIItemValue $l 'entries'))) {
                    if (Test-SICondition -Condition (Get-SIItemValue $entry 'when') -Item $Item -Context $Context) { return $true }
                }
                return $false
            }
            foreach ($v in (Get-SIValueList $actual)) { foreach ($e in (Get-SIValueList (Get-SIItemValue $l 'values'))) { if (Test-SIScalarEqual $v $e) { return $true } } }
            return $false
        }
        default { throw "unknown condition operation '$op' (field '$field')" }
    }
}

# ---- SI-Conditions.ps1 :: Test-SIConditionTri
function Test-SIConditionTri {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS  #546 UNKNOWN IS NEVER A FINDING. A condition evaluated in THREE states: $true, $false, or $null = unknown.
               A leaf is unknown when
                 * its field is in -UnknownFields (the CI build could not decide the field: the provider that decides it for
                   this identity's origin is not linked -- si_unknown_fields), or
                 * it compares a date or a number (older_than_days, newer_than_days, gt, gte, lt, lte) and the value is empty:
                   an age that was never read is not "older than 365 days".
               Every other leaf is Test-SICondition (so an empty value in a population leaf -- in, eq -- stays false: the
               item is simply not in the population). all: any false -> false, else any unknown -> unknown, else true.
               any: any true -> true, else any unknown -> unknown, else false.
               A caller counts a finding ONLY on $true; $null is counted as unknown.
    #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$Condition, $Item, [hashtable]$Context, [string[]]$UnknownFields = @())
    if ($null -eq $Condition) { return $true }
    $hasAll = ($Condition -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -and $Condition.Contains('all')) -or ($Condition.PSObject.Properties['all'])
    $hasAny = ($Condition -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -and $Condition.Contains('any')) -or ($Condition.PSObject.Properties['any'])
    if ($hasAll) {
        $unknown = $false
        foreach ($c in (Get-SIValueList (Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'all'))) {
            $r = Test-SIConditionTri -Condition $c -Item $Item -Context $Context -UnknownFields $UnknownFields
            if ($r -eq $false) { return $false }
            if ($null -eq $r) { $unknown = $true }
        }
        if ($unknown) { return $null }
        return $true
    }
    if ($hasAny) {
        $unknown = $false
        foreach ($c in (Get-SIValueList (Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'any'))) {
            $r = Test-SIConditionTri -Condition $c -Item $Item -Context $Context -UnknownFields $UnknownFields
            if ($r -eq $true) { return $true }
            if ($null -eq $r) { $unknown = $true }
        }
        if ($unknown) { return $null }
        return $false
    }
    $field = [string](Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'field')
    $op = [string](Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'op')
    foreach ($u in @($UnknownFields)) { if ($u -and [string]::Equals([string]$u, $field, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return $null } }
    if ($op -in 'older_than_days', 'newer_than_days', 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte') {
        if (Test-SIValueEmpty (Get-SIItemValue $Item $field)) { return $null }
    }
    return [bool](Test-SICondition -Condition $Condition -Item $Item -Context $Context)
}

# ---- SI-CiGraph.ps1 :: Get-SICiRelationClaims
function Get-SICiRelationClaims {
    <#
        PURE. The relation claims of one CI: per relation of -Rules whose 'from' holds the CI's class, per value of its field:
        OwnerCiId (the CI whose build made the claim), RelationId, Kind, FromCiId, ToType (ci | the identifier type | the
        node type), ToValue, Detail, Source, Confidence. An identifier or a node is lower case (the record identifiers are);
        a reversed relation runs from the value's CI to this one; a CI is never related to itself.
    #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$Ci, [AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Rules = @())
    $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $id = ([string](Get-SIItemValue $Ci 'si_ci_id')).Trim(); $cls = [string](Get-SIItemValue $Ci 'si_class')
    if (-not $id) { return }
    $seen = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]' ([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
    foreach ($r in @($Rules)) {
        if ($null -eq $r) { continue }
        if (@($r.from | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) -notcontains $cls) { continue }
        $raw = Get-SIItemValue $Ci ([string]$r.field)
        if (Test-SIValueEmpty $raw) { continue }
        $vp = [string[]]@(@(Get-SIItemValue $r 'valuePath') | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
        $dp = [string[]]@(@(Get-SIItemValue $r 'detailPath') | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
        $qual = ''
        $qf = [string](Get-SIItemValue $r 'qualifyWith'); if ($qf) { $qual = ([string](Get-SIItemValue $Ci $qf)).Trim().ToLowerInvariant() }
        foreach ($v in (Get-SICiRelationValues -Value $raw -ValuePath $vp -DetailPath $dp)) {
            $from = $id; $toType = ''; $toValue = ''
            switch ([string]$r.target) {
                'ci' { $toType = 'ci'; $toValue = $v.Value }
                'id' { $toType = [string]$r.idType; $toValue = $v.Value.ToLowerInvariant() }
                'node' {
                    $toType = [string]$r.nodeType; $toValue = $v.Value.ToLowerInvariant()
                    if ($qual) { $toValue = $qual + '/' + $toValue; if ($toValue.Length -gt 400) { $toValue = $toValue.Substring(0, 400) } }
                }
            }
            # an unknown target (Test-SIDataModel refuses one) makes no claim
            if (-not $toType) { continue }
            if ((Get-SIItemValue $r 'reverse') -eq $true) { $from = $v.Value; $toType = 'ci'; $toValue = $id }
            if ($toType -eq 'ci' -and ($from.Length -gt 64 -or $toValue.Length -gt 64)) { continue }
            if ($toType -eq 'ci' -and [string]::Equals($from, $toValue, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { continue }
            $sig = '{0}|{1}|{2}|{3}' -f $from, [string]$r.kind, $toType, $toValue
            if (-not $seen.Add($sig)) { continue }
            $out.Add([ordered]@{ OwnerCiId = $id; RelationId = [string]$r.id; Kind = [string]$r.kind; FromCiId = $from; ToType = $toType; ToValue = $toValue
                    Detail = $v.Detail; Source = [string]$r.source; Confidence = [string]$r.confidence })
        }
    }
    # the claims as items: @(Get-SICiRelationClaims ...) and a pipeline filter see each claim, never one array
    $out.ToArray()
}

# ---- SI-Classification.ps1 :: New-SIClassificationIndex
function New-SIClassificationIndex {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS  PURE. The merged templates -> what the evaluators walk: the targets in header order, each with its dimension's
               values and its rows (enabled and valid only), highest priority first (file order breaks a tie), each row's
               condition compiled once.
    #>
    param($Dimensions, $Classification)
    $dims = @{}
    foreach ($d in @(Get-SIItemValue $Dimensions 'dimensions')) { if ($null -ne $d -and @(Test-SIDimensionItem -Dimension $d).Count -eq 0) { $dims[[string]$d.id] = $d } }
    $targets = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
    $byField = @{}
    foreach ($t in @(Get-SIItemValue $Classification 'targets')) {
        if ($null -eq $t -or @(Test-SIClassificationTarget -Target $t -Dimensions $dims).Count -gt 0) { continue }
        $d = $dims[[string]$t.dimension]
        $e = [pscustomobject]@{ Field = [string]$t.field; Dimension = [string]$t.dimension; AppliesTo = [string]$t.appliesTo
                                Multi = ((ConvertTo-SIBoolOrNull (Get-SIItemValue $t 'multi')) -eq $true); Fallback = [string]$t.fallback
                                FallbackEmpty = [string](Get-SIItemValue $t 'fallbackEmpty'); KeepSourceIn = [string](Get-SIItemValue $t 'keepSourceIn')
                                Values = @(@($d.values) | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }); Rules = ([System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()) }
        $targets.Add($e); $byField[$e.Field] = $e
    }
    $tgDocs = @{}; foreach ($t in @(Get-SIItemValue $Classification 'targets')) { if ($t) { $tgDocs[[string]$t.field] = $t } }
    $n = 0
    foreach ($r in @(Get-SIItemValue $Classification 'rules')) {
        if ($null -eq $r) { continue }
        $n++
        if ([string](Get-SIItemValue $r 'state') -eq 'disabled') { continue }
        if (@(Test-SIClassificationRule -Rule $r -Targets $tgDocs -Dimensions $dims).Count -gt 0) { continue }
        $e = $byField[[string]$r.target]; if ($null -eq $e) { continue }
        $f = [string]$r.field
        $e.Rules.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Id = [string]$r.id; Value = [string]$r.set; Priority = [double](ConvertTo-SINumberOrNull $r.priority); Order = $n
                                        SourcePath = $(if (Test-SIClassificationSiField $f) { '' } else { $f }); Condition = (ConvertTo-SIClassificationCondition -Rule $r) })
    }
    foreach ($e in $targets) {
        $sorted = @($e.Rules.ToArray() | Sort-Object -Property @{ Expression = { $_.Priority }; Descending = $true }, @{ Expression = { $_.Order }; Descending = $false })
        $e.Rules.Clear(); foreach ($x in $sorted) { $e.Rules.Add($x) }
    }
    # .ToArray(), never @() around a List[object] held in an object: pwsh 7 throws "Argument types do not match"
    $hasPath = (@($targets.ToArray() | ForEach-Object { $_.Rules.ToArray() } | Where-Object { $_.SourcePath }).Count -gt 0)
    [pscustomobject]@{ Targets = $targets.ToArray(); HasSourcePath = $hasPath; Cache = @{} }
}

# ---- SI-Classification.ps1 :: Get-SIClassificationValue
function Get-SIClassificationValue {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS  PURE. One target over one item: @{ Values (the value, or for multi every value); Rules (the deciding row ids);
               Unknown (rows whose condition could not be decided) }. Values is empty when no row matched -- the caller
               applies the fallback.
    #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$Target, $Item, [hashtable]$Context, [string[]]$UnknownFields = @())
    $vals = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    $ids = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    $unknown = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    foreach ($r in $Target.Rules) {
        if ($Target.Multi -and $vals.Contains($r.Value)) { continue }
        $subject = $Item
        if ($r.SourcePath) {
            # a source-path row: the path's values become '$value' of a view that also carries the item's SI fields (for 'when')
            $view = @{}
            if ($Item -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) { foreach ($k in @($Item.Keys)) { $view[[string]$k] = $Item[$k] } }
            elseif ($null -ne $Item) { foreach ($pp in $Item.PSObject.Properties) { $view[$pp.Name] = $pp.Value } }
            $view['$value'] = @(Resolve-SIClassificationPath -Item $Item -Path $r.SourcePath)
            $subject = $view
        }
        $hit = $false
        try { $hit = Test-SIConditionTri -Condition $r.Condition -Item $subject -Context $Context -UnknownFields $UnknownFields } catch { $hit = $false }
        if ($null -eq $hit) { $unknown.Add($r.Id); continue }
        if ($hit -ne $true) { continue }
        $vals.Add($r.Value); $ids.Add($r.Id)
        if (-not $Target.Multi) { break }
    }
    if ($Target.Multi -and $vals.Count -gt 1) {
        # the dimension's own value order, so the same asset always reads the same way
        $ordered = @($Target.Values | Where-Object { $vals -contains $_ })
        $vals.Clear(); foreach ($v in $ordered) { $vals.Add($v) }
    }
    @{ Values = $vals.ToArray(); Rules = $ids.ToArray(); Unknown = $unknown.ToArray() }
}

# ---- SI-Classification.ps1 :: Invoke-SIAssetClassification
function Invoke-SIAssetClassification {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS  PURE. Every asset target on ONE CI (an ordered dictionary): writes the target field (and keepSourceIn), and
               si_classified_by (target field -> the row ids that decided, or 'fallback').
    #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$Ci, [Parameter(Mandatory)]$Index, [hashtable]$Context)
    $unknownFields = @(@(Get-SIItemValue $Ci 'si_unknown_fields') | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
    $by = [ordered]@{}
    foreach ($t in @($Index.Targets)) {
        if ($t.AppliesTo -ne 'asset') { continue }
        $src = Get-SIItemValue $Ci $t.Field
        if ($t.KeepSourceIn) {
            # the value the sources gave, kept once: a CI classified before (an incremental build) keeps its source value
            $prev = Get-SIItemValue $Ci $t.KeepSourceIn
            if (-not (Test-SIValueEmpty $prev)) { $src = $prev } else { $Ci[$t.KeepSourceIn] = $src }
        }
        $r = Get-SIClassificationValue -Target $t -Item $Ci -Context $Context -UnknownFields $unknownFields
        $vals = @($r.Values); $decided = @($r.Rules)
        if ($vals.Count -eq 0) {
            if ($t.Fallback -eq '$keep') {
                $sv = @((Get-SIValueList $src).ToArray() | Where-Object { -not (Test-SIValueEmpty $_) })
                if ($sv.Count) { $vals = @([string]$sv[0]) } else { $vals = @($t.FallbackEmpty) }
            } else { $vals = @($t.Fallback) }
            $decided = @('fallback')
        }
        if ($t.Multi) { $Ci[$t.Field] = [string[]]$vals } else { $Ci[$t.Field] = [string]$vals[0] }
        $by[$t.Field] = $decided
    }
    $Ci['si_classified_by'] = $by
    $Ci
}

# ---- SI-RiskFactorCatalog.ps1 :: Get-SIRiskFactorConditionLeaves
function Get-SIRiskFactorConditionLeaves {
    <# PURE. Every leaf condition (field / op / value) of a condition group. #>
    param($Condition)
    $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    if ($null -eq $Condition) { return , $out }
    foreach ($k in 'all', 'any') {
        $hasK = ($Condition -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -and $Condition.Contains($k)) -or ($Condition.PSObject.Properties[$k])
        if ($hasK) { foreach ($c in (Get-SIValueList (Get-SIItemValue $Condition $k))) { foreach ($l in (Get-SIRiskFactorConditionLeaves $c)) { $out.Add($l) } }; return , $out }
    }
    if (Get-SIItemValue $Condition 'field') { $out.Add($Condition) }
    return , $out
}

# ---- SI-RiskFactorCatalog.ps1 :: Get-SIRiskFactorCiColumns
function Get-SIRiskFactorCiColumns {
    <# PURE. The factors that get their own SI_CI_CL column (si_rf_<id>): catalog asset factors marked ciColumn. #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$Factors)
    @(@($Factors.factors) | Where-Object { $_ -and [string]$_.appliesTo -eq 'asset' -and [string]$_.evaluatedBy -eq 'catalog' -and (ConvertTo-SIBoolOrNull (Get-SIItemValue $_ 'ciColumn')) -eq $true } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.id })
}

# ---- SI-RiskFactorCatalog.ps1 :: Add-SICiRiskFactorEvidence
function Add-SICiRiskFactorEvidence {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS  PURE. #464 -- the catalog's factors PER CI, with their evidence, after Invoke-SICiRiskFactors evaluated them:
                 * every si_risk_factors entry gets 'evidence' (one item per provider that proves it: provider, SI field,
                   the provider fields of its mapping, the record, stale) and 'by' (those providers)
                 * de-duplicated across providers: ONE entry per factor, however many providers prove it
                 * si_rf_<id> = true / false for every factor the catalog marks ciColumn, si_rf_count = the factors that
                   count (production, impact > 0) -- the SI_CI_CL columns Risk Analysis can read without parsing JSON
               Evidence comes from si_field_sources (the CI build's source of truth per field); for a risk boolean resolved
               any-true it lists EVERY provider that said true (si_field_sources.<field>.providers). A computed field (si_tier)
               names what computed it; an address in a network range names the range list.
    #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$Ci, [Parameter(Mandatory)]$Factors, [hashtable]$Lists = @{})
    $byId = @{}; foreach ($f in @($Factors.factors)) { if ($f) { $byId[[string]$f.id] = $f } }
    $src = Get-SIItemValue $Ci 'si_field_sources'
    $count = 0
    $present = @{}
    foreach ($e in @($Ci['si_risk_factors'])) {
        if ($null -eq $e) { continue }
        $id = [string](Get-SIItemValue $e 'id')
        $f = $byId[$id]
        $ev = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
        if ($f) {
            $provBlock = Get-SIItemValue $f 'providers'
            # an ANY factor: only the fields whose own condition holds are its evidence (an address outside every range
            # proves nothing); fields read through a conditions list always count
            $isAny = (($f.when -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -and $f.when.Contains('any')) -or $f.when.PSObject.Properties['any'])
            $holds = @{}; $leafFields = @{}
            foreach ($leaf in (Get-SIRiskFactorConditionLeaves $f.when)) {
                $lf = [string]$leaf.field; $leafFields[$lf] = $true
                if ([string](Get-SIItemValue $leaf 'op') -eq 'in_list') { continue }
                $ok = $false; try { $ok = Test-SICondition -Condition $leaf -Item $Ci -Context @{ Lists = $Lists } } catch { $ok = $false }
                if ($ok) { $holds[$lf] = $true }
            }
            foreach ($field in (Get-SIRiskFactorProofFields -Factor $f -Lists $Lists)) {
                if ($isAny -and $leafFields.ContainsKey($field) -and -not $holds.ContainsKey($field)) { continue }
                $s = Get-SIItemValue $src $field
                $val = Get-SIItemValue $Ci $field
                if ($null -eq $s -and (Test-SIValueEmpty $val) -and -not ($val -is [bool])) { continue }
                $provs = @()
                if ($s) { $provs = (Get-SIValueList (Get-SIItemValue $s 'providers')).ToArray(); if ($provs.Count -eq 0 -and (Get-SIItemValue $s 'provider')) { $provs = @(([string](Get-SIItemValue $s 'provider')) -split ',' | Where-Object { $_ }) } }
                if ($provs.Count -eq 0) {
                    $why = ''; if ($field -eq 'si_tier') { $why = [string](Get-SIItemValue $Ci 'si_tier_reason') }
                    $ev.Add([ordered]@{ provider = 'computed'; field = $field; reason = $why }); continue
                }
                foreach ($pv in $provs) {
                    $pfs = @()
                    if ($provBlock) { foreach ($it in (Get-SIValueList (Get-SIItemValue $provBlock ([string]$pv)))) { if ([string](Get-SIItemValue $it 'siField') -eq $field) { $pfs += (Get-SIValueList (Get-SIItemValue $it 'sources')).ToArray() } } }
                    $rec = $null; if ($s -and [string](Get-SIItemValue $s 'provider') -eq [string]$pv) { $rec = Get-SIItemValue $s 'record' }
                    # no observed_at: it moves every build and would make every CI "changed" (the build sends only changed CIs)
                    $ev.Add([ordered]@{ provider = [string]$pv; field = $field; providerFields = @($pfs | Select-Object -Unique); record = $rec; stale = $(if ($s) { [bool](Get-SIItemValue $s 'stale') } else { $false }) })
                }
            }
            foreach ($leaf in (Get-SIRiskFactorConditionLeaves $f.when)) {
                if ([string](Get-SIItemValue $leaf 'op') -ne 'in_ranges') { continue }
                $one = [ordered]@{ field = [string]$leaf.field; op = 'in_ranges'; value = $leaf.value }
                $hit = $false; try { $hit = Test-SICondition -Condition $one -Item $Ci -Context @{ Lists = $Lists } } catch { $hit = $false }
                if ($hit) { $ev.Add([ordered]@{ provider = 'network'; field = [string]$leaf.field; list = [string]$leaf.value }) }
            }
        }
        if ($e -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) { $e['evidence'] = $ev.ToArray(); $e['by'] = @($ev | ForEach-Object { $_.provider } | Select-Object -Unique) }
        else { $e | Add-Member -NotePropertyName evidence -NotePropertyValue $ev.ToArray() -Force; $e | Add-Member -NotePropertyName by -NotePropertyValue @($ev | ForEach-Object { $_.provider } | Select-Object -Unique) -Force }
        $imp = ConvertTo-SINumberOrNull (Get-SIItemValue $e 'impact')
        if ($null -ne $imp -and $imp -gt 0) { $count++; $present[$id] = $true }
    }
    # #546 a factor the CI could not decide (si_rf_unknown) is NULL in its column -- unknown, never false, never true
    $unk = @(@(Get-SIItemValue $Ci 'si_rf_unknown') | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
    foreach ($cid in (Get-SIRiskFactorCiColumns -Factors $Factors)) {
        if ($unk -contains $cid -and -not $present.ContainsKey($cid)) { $Ci['si_rf_' + $cid] = $null } else { $Ci['si_rf_' + $cid] = [bool]$present.ContainsKey($cid) }
    }
    $Ci['si_rf_count'] = $count
    return $Ci
}

# ---- SI-BreakGlass.ps1 :: Test-SIBreakGlassName
function Test-SIBreakGlassName {
    <# PURE. $true when -Text matches any glob pattern (case-insensitive, the whole text). #>
    param([AllowNull()][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text, [string[]]$Patterns = @())
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Text)) { return $false }
    foreach ($p in $Patterns) {
        $wc = New-Object System.Management.Automation.WildcardPattern($p, [System.Management.Automation.WildcardOptions]::IgnoreCase)
        if ($wc.IsMatch($Text.Trim())) { return $true }
    }
    return $false
}

# ---- identity/SI-ObjectIdentity.ps1 :: Get-SILedgerKey
function Get-SILedgerKey {
    <# The ledger's lookup key. Canonicalised and lower-cased, so one fact cannot have two spellings. #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Type,
          [Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Value)
    '{0}|{1}' -f (Get-SICanonicalIdType -Type $Type).ToLowerInvariant(), ([string]$Value).ToLowerInvariant()
}

# ---- identity/SI-ObjectIdentity.ps1 :: Resolve-SIObjectIdentity
function Resolve-SIObjectIdentity {
    <#
        Decide each group's SI_CorrelationId against the existing ledger, and say what the ledger must
        become. Returns decisions; it does not write anything.

        Ledger is a hashtable: "type|value" -> @{ CorrelationId; FirstSeen }.
        Absent or empty means a first run, in which case everything mints -- which is correct, and is
        also the disaster-recovery path.

          MINT   no identifier is known         -> derive a v5 id from the birth anchor
          REUSE  all known identifiers agree    -> take the existing id, record any new identifiers
          MERGE  identifiers name 2+ ids        -> keep the OLDEST, supersede the rest, emit old->new

        🔒 THE OLDEST SURVIVES, not the "best". Any other rule (lowest tier, most members, newest) makes
        the surviving id depend on this run's data, which is the exact property being removed. FirstSeen
        decides; an ordinal id compare breaks ties so two hosts never disagree.

        ◻ SPLIT DETECTION IS DEFERRED, AND DELIBERATELY NOT GUESSED. A genuine split -- one object whose
        identifiers stop co-occurring -- cannot be told apart from "a source failed and half the
        identifiers are missing this run" by looking at one run. Getting that wrong RETIRES A LIVE CI,
        which is worse than a late one. It needs either two consecutive runs agreeing or an explicit
        operator action, and that is a separate decision. What this DOES do is report the shrink
        (`ShrunkObjects`) so it is visible rather than silent.
        🔑 THE ONE EXCEPTION, #642: a group that PROVABLY is another object than the rest of its id (Test-SILedgerWrongMerge
        -- two or more types an object holds once, each with another value written in the same run) is split off: a source
        that failed cannot produce that, a fused group can. The object the id was minted from keeps it (Action 'split',
        Splits Kind 'wrong-merge', counted in WrongMergeSplit).

        🔴 -AmbiguousIdKeys (#61.4, added 2026-08-20 after a LIVE failure). Ledger keys carried by more
        than one object this run, which happens only when an operator never-merge kept two groups
        apart. Such a key identifies NEITHER group any more, so it is excluded from three places --
        and ALL THREE are required, or the fix does not survive to the next run:

          1. the `$known` LOOKUP   -- or the shared anchor drags both halves back onto one id
          2. the BIRTH ANCHOR      -- or both halves mint the SAME v5 id from the shared value
          3. the ledger WRITE-BACK -- or the re-minted half claims the shared anchor, and next run the
                                      other half follows it and they MERGE again

        Measured before the fix: `distinct durable ids: 1 for 2 objects`. The derived seed was already
        correct by then, so the published map looked right while the LEDGER re-fused them -- and a
        durable id is exactly the one a connector is permitted to create CIs from.
    #>
    param(
        # AllowNull as well as AllowEmptyCollection: a caller flattening several sources can hand us an
        # array with a null element, and binding must not refuse it. The loop skips nulls itself.
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowNull()][AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Groups,
        [Parameter()][hashtable]$Ledger,
        [Parameter()][datetime]$Now = ([datetime]'2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'),
        [Parameter()][AllowNull()][hashtable]$AmbiguousIdKeys
    )

    if ($null -eq $Ledger) { $Ledger = @{} }
    $hasAmbiguous = ($null -ne $AmbiguousIdKeys -and $AmbiguousIdKeys.Keys.Count -gt 0)

    $decisions   = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $superseded  = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $shrunk      = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $splits      = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $unkeyable   = 0
    $keysById    = $null   # the ledger's keys by id, built when the first object that is not new needs it
    $keeperKeys  = @{}      # #642 per ledger id: the key of the anchor whose object keeps the id

    foreach ($g in @($Groups)) {
        if ($null -eq $g) { continue }

        # Every identifier the group carries, across all members, canonicalised.
        $idsAll = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
        foreach ($m in @($g.Members)) {
            foreach ($id in (Get-SIMemberIdentifiers -Member $m)) {
                [void]$idsAll.Add([pscustomobject]@{
                    Type  = (Get-SICanonicalIdType -Type ([string]$id.Type))
                    Value = ([string]$id.Value).ToLowerInvariant()
                })
            }
        }

        # Identity is decided on the UNAMBIGUOUS subset. A group whose ONLY anchors are contested falls
        # back to the full set rather than being declared unkeyable -- it still needs an id, and the
        # collision pass below reports what could not be separated.
        $ids = $idsAll
        if ($hasAmbiguous) {
            $filtered = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
            foreach ($id in $idsAll) {
                if (-not $AmbiguousIdKeys.ContainsKey((Get-SILedgerKey -Type $id.Type -Value $id.Value))) {
                    [void]$filtered.Add($id)
                }
            }
            if ($filtered.Count -gt 0) { $ids = $filtered }
        }

        if ($ids.Count -eq 0) {
            # No anchor at all -- nothing to remember it by, so it cannot be given a durable identity.
            # Counted, never invented: minting for an unkeyable object would create a new id every run.
            $unkeyable++
            [void]$decisions.Add([pscustomobject]@{
                Group = $g; CorrelationId = $null; Action = 'unkeyable'
                BirthAnchor = $null; NewIdentifiers = @(); PriorIds = @()
            })
            continue
        }

        # Which existing ids do this group's identifiers already point at?
        $known = @{}
        foreach ($id in $ids) {
            # (a value longer than the ledger's column is held under its short form -- Get-SILedgerEntryKey finds both)
            $k = Get-SILedgerEntryKey -Ledger $Ledger -Type $id.Type -Value $id.Value
            if ($null -ne $k) {
                $e = $Ledger[$k]
                $cid = [string]$e.CorrelationId
                if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($cid) -and -not $known.ContainsKey($cid)) {
                    $known[$cid] = $e.FirstSeen
                }
            }
        }

        $anchor = Get-SIObjectBirthAnchor -Identifiers $ids.ToArray()
        $action = ''
        $cid    = $null
        $priors = @()

        if ($known.Keys.Count -eq 0) {
            $action = 'mint'
            $cid = (New-SIObjectUuidV5 -Name (Get-SILedgerKey -Type $anchor.Type -Value $anchor.Value)).ToString()
        }
        elseif ($known.Keys.Count -eq 1) {
            $action = 'reuse'
            $cid = @($known.Keys)[0]
        }
        else {
            # MERGE. Oldest FirstSeen wins; ordinal id compare breaks a tie deterministically.
            $action = 'merge'
            $ordered = @($known.Keys) | Sort-Object @{ Expression = { $known[$_] } }, @{ Expression = { $_ } }
            $oldest  = $null
            $oldestT = $null
            foreach ($k in @($known.Keys)) {
                $t = $known[$k]
                if ($null -eq $oldestT -or $t -lt $oldestT -or
                    ($t -eq $oldestT -and (@(Sort-SIOrdinal -Value @($k, $oldest))[0]) -eq $k)) {
                    $oldest = $k; $oldestT = $t
                }
            }
            $cid = $oldest
            $priors = @(@($known.Keys) | Where-Object { $_ -ne $cid })
            foreach ($old in $priors) {
                [void]$superseded.Add([pscustomobject]@{ OldId = $old; NewId = $cid; At = $Now })
            }
        }

        # Identifiers this object did not previously have under this id -- the ledger rows to add.
        $newIds = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
        foreach ($id in $ids) {
            $k = Get-SILedgerEntryKey -Ledger $Ledger -Type $id.Type -Value $id.Value
            if ($null -eq $k -or [string]$Ledger[$k].CorrelationId -ne $cid) {
                [void]$newIds.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Type = $id.Type; Value = $id.Value; CorrelationId = $cid })
            }
        }

        # #642 A WRONG MERGE IN THE LEDGER: this group resolved to an id that, by proof, also holds ANOTHER object (two or
        # more identifier types an object holds once, each with another value written in the same run -- Test-SILedgerWrongMerge).
        # The object the id was minted from (else the oldest) keeps it; this group becomes its own object, minted from its
        # own birth anchor, and its anchors are re-pointed -- so the next run reuses the new id and nothing splits again.
        # Decided per group from the ledger alone: a CI build batch that holds one of the objects decides exactly what a
        # batch holding all of them would.
        $idKeys = $null
        if ($action -eq 'reuse') {
            if ($null -eq $keysById) { $keysById = Get-SILedgerKeysById -Ledger $Ledger }
            $idKeys = @(Get-SILedgerKeysOfId -Index $keysById -Ledger $Ledger -CorrelationId $cid)
            $wm = Test-SILedgerWrongMerge -Ids $ids.ToArray() -Ledger $Ledger -AnchorKeys $idKeys
            if ($wm.Proven) {
                if (-not $keeperKeys.ContainsKey($cid)) { $keeperKeys[$cid] = Get-SILedgerIdKeeperKey -CorrelationId $cid -Ledger $Ledger -AnchorKeys $idKeys }
                $keeperKey = [string]$keeperKeys[$cid]
                $holdsKeeper = $false
                foreach ($id in $ids) {
                    if ((Get-SILedgerEntryKey -Ledger $Ledger -Type $id.Type -Value $id.Value) -eq $keeperKey) { $holdsKeeper = $true; break }
                }
                $newCid = (New-SIObjectUuidV5 -Name (Get-SILedgerKey -Type $anchor.Type -Value $anchor.Value)).ToString()
                if (-not $holdsKeeper -and $newCid -ne $cid) {
                    $rewritten = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
                    foreach ($id in $ids) { [void]$rewritten.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Type = $id.Type; Value = $id.Value; CorrelationId = $newCid }) }
                    [void]$splits.Add([pscustomobject]@{
                        CorrelationId = $cid; NewId = $newCid; Objects = 2; Resolved = $true; Kind = 'wrong-merge'
                        KeptBy = $keeperKey; Types = @($wm.Types)
                        Reason = ('the ledger id held another object as well ({0} differ, written in the same run) -- the object it was minted from keeps the id and this one is its own object' -f (@($wm.Types) -join ', '))
                    })
                    [void]$decisions.Add([pscustomobject]@{
                        Group = $g; CorrelationId = $newCid; Action = 'split'
                        BirthAnchor = $anchor; NewIdentifiers = $rewritten.ToArray(); PriorIds = @($cid)
                        Identifiers = $ids.ToArray()
                    })
                    continue
                }
            }
        }

        # Anchors the ledger holds for this id that did NOT appear this run. Reported, never acted on --
        # see the split note in the docblock.
        if ($action -ne 'mint') {
            $present = @{}
            foreach ($id in $ids) {
                $present[(Get-SILedgerKey -Type $id.Type -Value $id.Value)] = $true
                # a long value is in the ledger under its short form: it appeared this run all the same
                if (([string]$id.Value).Length -gt 256) { $present[(Get-SILedgerKey -Type $id.Type -Value (ConvertTo-SILedgerStoredValue -Value ([string]$id.Value)))] = $true }
            }
            # 🔴 THE LEDGER'S KEYS BY THE ID THEY POINT AT, built once (Get-SILedgerKeysById). This report used to read
            # EVERY ledger key for EVERY object: 28,822 objects against a ledger of well over 100,000 anchors was more
            # than an hour of one correlation run (2026-10-12), and the same again in every batch of the CI build.
            # The same keys are found, in the same order.
            if ($null -eq $keysById) { $keysById = Get-SILedgerKeysById -Ledger $Ledger }
            $missing = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
            if ($null -eq $idKeys) { $idKeys = @(Get-SILedgerKeysOfId -Index $keysById -Ledger $Ledger -CorrelationId $cid) }
            foreach ($k in $idKeys) {
                if (-not $present.ContainsKey($k)) { [void]$missing.Add($k) }
            }
            if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
                [void]$shrunk.Add([pscustomobject]@{ CorrelationId = $cid; MissingAnchors = $missing.ToArray() })
            }
        }

        [void]$decisions.Add([pscustomobject]@{
            Group = $g; CorrelationId = $cid; Action = $action
            BirthAnchor = $anchor; NewIdentifiers = $newIds.ToArray(); PriorIds = $priors
            Identifiers = $ids.ToArray()
        })
    }

    # ---- ONE LEDGER ID CLAIMED BY TWO OBJECTS -------------------------------------------------------
    #
    # 🔴 THIS IS THE OTHER HALF OF THE 2026-08-20 LIVE FAILURE, and excluding the contested anchor above
    # does NOT on its own fix it. Before a split every anchor of the original object points at that
    # object's id, so on the FIRST run after an operator separates it, BOTH halves still resolve to the
    # same id through their own perfectly unambiguous anchors. Measured: `1 distinct id for 2 objects`.
    #
    # 🔑 WHY IT IS SAFE TO ACT HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE. The docblock above refuses to auto-detect splits
    # because one run cannot tell "this object split" from "a source failed". That reasoning is intact:
    # this pass only reassigns when an OPERATOR never-merge produced the separation, which is exactly
    # the missing fact. Two groups that collide WITHOUT one are reported and left alone -- the deferred
    # case, now at least visible instead of silently sharing an id.
    $byId = @{}
    foreach ($d in $decisions) {
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$d.CorrelationId)) { continue }
        $k = [string]$d.CorrelationId
        if (-not $byId.ContainsKey($k)) { $byId[$k] = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object] }
        [void]$byId[$k].Add($d)
    }

    foreach ($k in @($byId.Keys)) {
        # 🪤 .ToArray(), NOT @(...). On PS 5.1 wrapping a List[object] of PSCustomObjects in @() throws
        # "Argument types do not match" -- and it threw here on the very first call, before any
        # collision existed, so it would have taken down every correlation run.
        $claimants = $byId[$k].ToArray()
        if ($claimants.Count -lt 2) { continue }

        $separated = @($claimants | Where-Object { $_.Group -and $_.Group.PSObject.Properties['SeparatedByDecision'] -and $_.Group.SeparatedByDecision })
        if ($separated.Count -lt 2) {
            # Not operator-separated: the deferred split/reassign case. Report, never act.
            [void]$splits.Add([pscustomobject]@{
                CorrelationId = $k; Objects = $claimants.Count; Resolved = $false; Kind = 'collision'
                Reason = 'two or more objects resolve to one ledger id and no operator decision separated them -- reported, not acted on (see V3-ARCHITECTURE 2.3a)'
            })
            continue
        }

        # WHICH HALF KEEPS THE EXISTING ID. Ordinal compare of each half's own birth-anchor ledger key.
        #
        # 🔑 It is a TIEBREAK, not a claim about which half is "really" the original -- nothing in one
        # run can establish that. What it must be is DETERMINISTIC and STABLE: a rule that flipped
        # between runs would move the CI back and forth, which is worse than either choice. Ordinal
        # (never culture-sensitive) so two hosts cannot disagree.
        # 📌 The operator overrides it with `pin-id`, which is precisely what that kind is for.
        # 🪤 ORDINAL SCAN, not Sort-Object, and NO `u ESCAPE.
        # Two host traps in one line, both found on a LIVE pwsh 7 run while the PS 5.1 Pester suite
        # stayed green (framework finding HOST-1: the suites run on 5.1, the engines on 7):
        #   * "`uffff" is a pwsh 7 escape. On 5.1 it is the literal text "uffff" and parses fine; on
        #     pwsh 7 it is a PARSE ERROR, which took the whole ledger block down to
        #     "identity ledger unavailable -- publishing with DERIVED, PROVISIONAL ids".
        #   * Sort-Object is culture-sensitive, and this choice decides which CI keeps its identity.
        #     A da-DK host must not keep a different half than an en-US one.
        $keeper    = $null
        $keeperKey = $null
        foreach ($d in $claimants) {
            if (-not $d.BirthAnchor) { continue }
            $dk = Get-SILedgerKey -Type $d.BirthAnchor.Type -Value $d.BirthAnchor.Value
            if ($null -eq $keeperKey -or [string]::CompareOrdinal($dk, $keeperKey) -lt 0) {
                $keeper = $d; $keeperKey = $dk
            }
        }
        # Every claimant lacks a birth anchor: nothing to re-mint from, so leave them reported.
        if ($null -eq $keeper) {
            [void]$splits.Add([pscustomobject]@{
                CorrelationId = $k; Objects = $claimants.Count; Resolved = $false; Kind = 'operator'
                Reason = 'operator-separated, but no half carries an unambiguous anchor to mint a new id from -- reported, not acted on'
            })
            continue
        }
        $ranked = $claimants

        foreach ($d in $ranked) {
            if ($d -eq $keeper) { continue }
